panel-width.$description: New token, the width of ColorPicker's panel: wide enough for a saturation and brightness area that is comfortable to aim in, the hue and alpha sliders, a row of swatches and the field of the typed value, narrow enough to sit in a phone's width beside a gap at each edge. The spacing scale stops at space.32 (8rem) and has nothing near this.

area-height.$description: New token, the height of the saturation and brightness area. Between space.32 (8rem) and the panel's width, which gives a 7:4 area that is tall enough to separate nearby brightness steps by a few pixels each.

thumb-size.$description: New token, the diameter of the thumb on the area and on the hue and alpha sliders: a white ring inside a black one around the color under it. space.5 is the same 1.25rem, but the thumb is a control's own size, not a space between things. The pointer and touch target is extended to 24 x 24px (WCAG 2.5.8) by an invisible ::before, as Slider's is.

slider-track-height.$description: New token, the thickness of the hue and alpha sliders' tracks: thick enough that the gradient reads as a color, not a line. It is space.3, but a track's thickness is the slider's own measure.

swatch-size.$description: New token, the side of a swatch button in the panel's list of colors: 24px, the WCAG 2.5.8 target-size floor, so every swatch is a valid target at every size step of the field.
